title: Last Call
place: Mia's food truck, after the lunch rush

opening.title: After the rush
opening.line: The lunch crowd is gone. Mia is scraping the flat-top and pretending she isn't waiting for you.
choices: Save me the crispy bits. I'm not sharing either.
You're in a good mood. What's the occasion?
Close up early. Walk with me.

notes: The four-heart showcase: Mia is the most openly enthusiastic of the four, so her Close route is warm and eager before it becomes shy.
